scope: First four PDE reports: Armstrong-Kuusi, Berti, Cabre and Colombo. The Deng, Elgindi and Faure working-tree additions are not part of this release.

independent_build.method: Build the exact commit and recorded theme commit in a clean archive, excluding all current working-tree additions and unrelated local changes.

live_verification.comparison: Entire HTML compared with the independent build. Only between-tag and display-math-boundary indentation is normalized; 190 normalized matches, including 8 byte-identical compatibility pages.
live_verification.tls: NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=1 with default HTTPS verification; no insecure overrides.

historical_records: icm2026-pde-first-validation.json records the earlier local validation state. This separate record establishes later push, deployment and live acceptance.
